pages.text: Load both block and entity wagons. Hold an allowed single-block item and use an empty cargo slot. Cargo is scaled down, remains solid and faces relative to your placement position.$(br2)Standard boxes have 2 × 5 slots (10); extended boxes 2 × 6 (12); wide boxes 4 × 8 (32).

Sneak-use cargo to unload it into your inventory; overflow drops into the world. Beds, doors and other multiblock structures are rejected. By default, wagon parts are also blacklisted as ordinary cargo.$(br2)Fabric does not hide cargo, but blocks interactions through it. Open the tailgate or curtains and use an unobstructed path.

Use the rear tailgate to open or close it in either wagon form. It folds outward and hangs down, making rear access easier.$(br2)Opening it adds no cargo slots and does not unload anything automatically. A canopy’s rear curtains must be opened separately. Covered cargo remains accessible from behind when fabric does not obstruct the path.
